description: As political leaders, industry pioneers and experts from around the world gather in Shanghai for the 2026 World AI Conference and High-Level Meeting on Global AI Governance, we explore key questions facing global AI governance today: What are the biggest challenges now? How can countries compete while working together on safety and governance? And how can the world ensure that AI narrows, not widens, the global development gap? Host Dou Hongyu is joined by Josef Gregory Mahoney, Professor of Pol…
classificationReason: The panel is broadly about AI governance but includes an embodied-intelligence and robotics expert, creating a substantial adjacent segment.
qualityReason: Expert panel format with named academics and a focused discussion of governance, safety, cooperation, and development impact.
